October 21 article acceptance is gated on two open PRs: daily-logger #417 (fix: size complete action evidence coverage) and #416 (editorial: review and accept October 21 draft). Both were opened before the 2026-10-22 03:30 America/Chicago cutoff but are not yet merged; their current state is unknown beyond creation timestamps. Issue #386 (token-aware action review budget) is the structural concern backing both PRs.

Classic Space Venue dev-host is a local development environment — no public URL is attested. The provenance fixture path inside the walkway-pass strand is not explicitly attested beyond PR descriptions. No live adapter is active, no minifig is bound to a fleet-runner work item, and no idle/auto-degrade timer exists. Display composition issues #5 (32-inch desk-monitor) and #6 (narrow remote-browser) are owner-gated on operator hardware access. Core #561 (fleet-runner read-projection v0) is the architectural prerequisite for live data; owner and delivery timeline are unattested.

Classic-space-venue #4 (RFI-0002 research harness) is open and awaiting review; it is not confirmed how long it has been open or who is reviewing it. Whether the core wayfinder grilling cluster (#564–#567, #544) can progress independently of that harness merging is not established.

Lego-village-pipeline DRAFT PRs #44, #45, #46 carry no in-window activity. Their named merge prerequisite conditions are not attested in current evidence; they are not confirmed candidates to close.

Morning-cockpit #60 is open with no stated blocker or owner gate.

Skill telemetry stream frozen since 2026-05-12. No owner, remediation date, or formal park decision attested in evidence. The 100% quality coverage metric and 0% conversion rate are both artifacts of the frozen legacy stream, not live measurements.
